Create a sparse sunlit Wild West settlement on flat dusty earth, enclosed by sandstone outcrops on three sides and open on the fourth. Arrange roughly eight wooden buildings in two loose rows facing a wide dirt street, including a timber church with a bell tower, clapboard houses and shops, and simple sheds. Keep generous empty margins between the town and cliffs. Wrap much of the developed area in a low picket fence with openings for paths and a railway. Bring a short straight track from the open side toward the church, carrying a black steam locomotive and tender. Add telegraph poles, barrels, hitching posts, and two groups of period vehicles along one outer side.
